models.summary: Requests to gemini-2.5-pro are routed to Gemini 3.8 Flash and billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates.
Requests to gemini-2.5-flash are routed to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates.
